evidence.quote: AWS does not charge an additional fee for the zero-ETL integration. You pay for source and target resources used to create and process the changed data created as part of a zero-ETL integration.
AWS Glue charges a fee for the ingestion of application source data supported by zero-ETL integration.

claim: AWS does not charge an additional fee for the zero-ETL integration, and you pay for source and target resources used to create and process the changed data; for application sources, AWS Glue charges a fee for the ingestion of application source data supported by zero-ETL integration.
note: d007 | adjudicate-35 moved from condition (not carried by the quote): The page also says AWS Glue charges a fee for the ingestion of application source data supported by zero-ETL integration, based on the volume of data received.
